_comment: Composition (form) and functional fit checks of asset.check and the studio step stats (satk.style.form, satk.style.fit).
They report DEFECTS and WARNINGS with locations, never numbers to chase. Calibrated on every vanilla model of SA 1.0 US
(14,790 models, every class): asset.check shows 0 defects on them. 'strict_classes' (road cars, motorbikes) have no
floating piece, loose body, box corner or see-through arch in vanilla: every such finding is a defect. Every other class
follows 'classes': the vanilla patterns are encoded as allowed (map models stand on the terrain or hang on walls and
ceilings of other models, alpha cards, decal cards, separate components of upgrades and LODs, parts the game animates or
shows one at a time); a finding beyond the class's vanilla range is a defect, a smaller one a warning (vanilla has such
near misses; asset.check --strict blocks them). Allowed hovers everywhere: flat cards (plates, gauges, steering card),
glass panes behind their frame, small heads (mirror heads on stalks), tiny bits, opening panels at their shut line,
and anything hidden inside the body from all six axis directions. symmetry: information only.

Limits that replace the class limits for an authored model (a kit export, a model of an asset project): vanilla map models rest on neighbouring models, an authored asset stands on its own, so a separate group off the model's foot or beside its body floats.

lod.silhouette (satk.style.lodcheck): the share of the HD outline its LOD covers from the side, the front and above; calibrated on 56 vanilla buildings with a LOD (p5 0.42, p25 0.72): below warn_coverage, or a LOD outline more than warn_spill bigger than the HD's, it is a warning (vanilla has thin decks and lost railings); asset.check --strict blocks a LOD that keeps less than 'under' of data/style/strict.json (its walls lost); flat ground pieces are not compared.
form.dense_flat (satk.style.form.dense_flat): fine triangles on flat or gently curved surface. A welded vertex is redundant
when it could collapse into a neighbour with its faces staying within dense_fold_deg (8 deg) and its edges are shorter than
dense_fine_mm (10 cm) on average; seams (material, UV, normals), open edges and double-sided cards never count. wasted = 2
triangles per redundant vertex. A finding = wasted >= dense_min_tris and wasted / triangles >= dense_share (0.33).
Calibrated on all 14,790 vanilla models of SA 1.0 US: 0 findings; the highest share with at least 100 wasted triangles is
0.261 (kmb_dumbbell2, a gym prop placed by script), the most wasted 614 at a share of 0.08 (Boxkitch, an interior shell).
Map models placed 50+ times waste at most 20 triangles, 10-49 times at most 168 (share 0.13): a map model is placed many
times, so beyond the vanilla range it is a review defect for the map family; vehicles (at most 192, share 0.14), peds,
weapons, upgrades and pickups get it as advice (a warning that never blocks --strict). The bin of the first atelier run: 1,774
of 4,062 triangles (0.437), a subdivided smooth barrel with 4 deg folds and 5 cm edges; vanilla bins are 16 segments around
(22.5 deg folds) with long strips. Never a triangle cap: rich detail that turns the outline is never counted.
Composition rules per class (satk.style.check.class_rules): merged default <- family <- parent
classes <- the class. checks: form checks to run; ground: what carries a piece besides the body
(anchor = only what touches the body; world = also groups with nothing of the model under them,
map models stand on the terrain; loose = also separate components farther than loose_near_mm);
floating_defect_mm: a floating group with a larger gap is a defect, a smaller one a warning (vanilla
shows such near misses; asset.check --strict blocks them too); far_defect: a group with nothing
within gap_search_mm is a defect; fit_skip: fit checks that do not apply; limits: form limits.

vehicle._fit_skip: tandem middle axles share the rear arch

plane._fit_skip: canopies slide or pivot in the middle; wheels sit in spats and gear legs

heli._fit_skip: canopies and sliding doors; wheels in spats

car.truck_bus._fit_skip: box-truck rear doors roll or split in the middle; the fuel tank is under the frame

quad._see_through: quads have open fenders, no arches
